protocol.pin_status: Resolve and snapshot an immutable commit with fetch-protocol before preparing media.
protocol.anchor_rule: First and third paths of each official list row; normalized endpoint times 0 and 1.
protocol.target_rule: Every consecutive integer source frame between endpoints, at i/factor for i=1..factor-1.
protocol.resolution: native RGB; no resize or spatial crop
protocol.context: Two endpoints only, independently for each interval; no visual context across requests.
protocol.scoring: Balanced LPIPS-Alex v0.1 / sequence FloLPIPS with diagnostic RGB PSNR; see ../METRICS.md. Measured calibration is pending; not a reproduction of published scores.

dataset.name: snu-film-arb
dataset.artifact: snufilm-test.zip (all RGB frames, not selected triplets), plus original test-medium/hard/extreme.txt lists
dataset.split_unit: original recording across all subclips, intervals, and factors; explicit operator group map required
dataset.license: Unresolved for dataset media; the CAIN code license does not establish rights to GoPro/YouTube footage.

secondary_benchmarks: Deferred; X-TEST can be added later as a separate stress test, not mixed into the primary set.
